generations.prompt: Brumekin, a chunky round chibi brute monster for a JRPG side-view battle, standing, facing right. Big round dark indigo-purple body, two curved golden-yellow horns on top, small angry white eyes looking right, a glowing orange ember belly patch, small stubby dark fist in front, short gold-brown feet. Idle stance. Large sprite that fills the canvas height. Clean readable pixel art sprite with dark plum outline, single character centred, feet at the bottom, transparent background.
idle breathing loop: round body rises and falls slightly, ember belly pulses, feet stay planted in place
body slam attack: crouches down to wind up, then hops forward to the right and slams its whole round body forward, then steps back to its stance
casting a fire skill: plants its feet and puffs up, the ember belly glows brighter and flames flicker up around it, then it settles
taking a hit: flinches backwards to the left, squeezes eyes shut with a pained face, body squashes, then recovers
death: staggers, eyes go dizzy, tips over backwards and flops onto the ground, the ember belly dims and goes dark, lying still
